description:
Pocket Mole turns your Apple Watch into a tiny arcade reflex challenge. Tap popping moles, keep your combo streak alive, chase a higher score, and race through quick 30-second rounds built for spare moments.

Golden moles add bonus points, final-rush timing raises the pressure, and crisp haptic feedback makes every hit feel satisfying on your wrist. It is simple to start, fast to replay, and perfect when you want a cheerful score attack without pulling out your phone.
promotionalText: A tiny arcade score chase for Apple Watch: tap fast, build streaks, and feel every golden mole hit.
whatsNew: Added stronger haptic feedback for combo streaks and golden moles!
